summary: Cold call editor: a vertical video whose sound is a recorded phone call becomes a short in the Pipecorn call language (the most suspenseful line as a glitched hook, the call placed on a ringing paper sheet, then the conversation typed out as a record with the voice as one line of wave, -14 LUFS). Runs on the short-editor's engine.

prerequisites.label: The video engine (the short-editor skill's scripts)
prerequisites.hint: The cold call editor renders with the short editor's engine: keep both skills installed.

prerequisites.label: Rendering engine (node packages)
prerequisites.hint: Installed on first run by the engine's bootstrap.mjs.

prerequisites.label: Speech-to-text (Whisper, on your Mac's GPU)
prerequisites.hint: Installed on first run by the engine's bootstrap.mjs.

prerequisites.label: Music shelf (4 Mixkit tracks + 2 of the sound pack)
prerequisites.hint: The Mixkit tracks download from mixkit.co on first run; the other two come with the app's sound pack (not Mixkit: fine in a video, they can block its monetisation).

prerequisites.label: SFX pack (flash, click, whoosh, glitch, riser)
prerequisites.hint: Kept in the shelf; init.sh copies it into every project.

prerequisites.label: Swift compiler (the person matte: what is named comes out from behind you)
ELEVENLABS_API_KEY (your voice made better, a bonus)
prerequisites.hint: Your own ElevenLabs key: in the app, Settings › Connectors › Add key. Only for the bonus « Your voice made better » (ElevenLabs' voice isolator: the room's echo and the noise out of your take), billed by ElevenLabs per minute of sound.
prerequisites.offer: Your voice can be made better (the room's echo and the noise taken out) with an ElevenLabs key. Without one, the take's own sound is used.
